proposal.quote: Both the military party and politicians had all, with the exception of Goebbels and Goering, advised against the re-occupation of the Rhineland. Hitler felt however this must be done so as to have a “fait accompli” prior to the elections.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports the re-occupation of the Rhineland as an accomplished fact (a fait accompli before the elections), which meets the remilitarized threshold of German troops garrisoned in the zone.

proposal.quote: occupation of the Rhineland by German military forces
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports German military forces occupying the Rhineland, which meets the threshold for a remilitarized zone (German troops garrisoned in the zone).

proposal.quote: the German reoccupation of the Rhineland
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The despatch reports the German reoccupation of the Rhineland, meeting the threshold of German troops garrisoned in the zone.

proposal.quote: Disputes even as antagonistic as Anglo-Italian relations today
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The ambassador describes current Anglo-Italian relations as antagonistic in the context of the Italo-Abyssinian affair, meeting the estranged threshold.

proposal.quote: Flandin and associates now admit they must talk with Germans but hope to postpone these conversations until after French elections.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The threshold for limited is that the French government treats German aims as revision that a negotiated settlement can satisfy, which this reported French willingness to talk with Berlin meets; the reading is second-hand and partial, so low confidence.

proposal.quote: Great Britain in her attitude against Italy has in this respect the support of wide popular opinion to count upon.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports British hostility toward Italy over its African war, meeting the threshold of Italy being estranged from the West after Ethiopia.

proposal.quote: The Belgian Government is still fearful of a split between Great Britain and France regarding the question of sanctions against Italy
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports League sanctions against Italy as an active question dividing the Western powers, the condition that keeps Italy estranged from the West after Ethiopia.

proposal.quote: The British Government will now approach the German Government and ask for clarifications of certain points raised in the German Government’s last memorandum. In this inquiry, the latest French memorandum will serve as a basis.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports the British, French and Belgian governments continuing a diplomatic inquiry with Berlin with no fixed plan, which meets the appease level's element of a policy seeking a settlement rather than a commitment to fight.

proposal.quote: Italy will be entirely successful in her present Abyssinian adventure ... England is now aware of her military weakness and is taking measures to remedy it so that when the time is ripe she will be able to take her revenge on Italy.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports Italy's ongoing Abyssinian war and British hostility/revenge toward Italy, meeting the threshold for Italy being estranged from the West after Ethiopia.

proposal.quote: the Ethiopian-Italian dispute ... sanctions which, although loyally supported by this country, are a constant source of annoyance and economic dislocation
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports League sanctions against Italy in force and supported by Czechoslovakia, meeting the threshold for Italy estranged from the West after Ethiopia.

proposal.quote: the attempt with which England and Germany are both so concerned to bring about better general European relations and conditions
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports British and German concern to improve general European relations, showing a policy seeking a settlement under the appease threshold.

proposal.quote: Regarding the recent collapse of the League of Nations respecting Abyssinia... the community of Anglo-German interests vis-à-vis Italian imperialism
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports the League's collapse over Abyssinia and Anglo-German interests aligned against Italian imperialism, indicating Italy's estrangement from the West.

proposal.quote: the stimulating effects of the Rhineland occupation have worn off
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports the Rhineland occupation as an accomplished fact, meeting the threshold that German troops are garrisoned in the zone.

proposal.quote: a French withdrawal from a continuation of sanctions against Italy
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports sanctions against Italy continuing, which is the condition keeping Italy estranged from the West.

proposal.quote: the German re-militarization of the Rhineland
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports the German re-militarization of the Rhineland, the event that placed German troops in the zone from 7 March 1936, meeting the remilitarized threshold.

proposal.quote: the British note of inquiry as to the meaning of Hitler’s peace proposals
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports the British note of inquiry to Berlin about Hitler's peace proposals, the sort of questionnaire the threshold treats as London still seeking a negotiated settlement and thus holding a limited view of German aims.

proposal.quote: until the German fortifications had been constructed on the French border an involvement of Germany in war with Italy might lead to a French attack on Germany
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage records German policy caution and doubt about a French attack before the fortifications are built, fitting the uncertain level's provision against Western intervention.

proposal.quote: which again in 1936 insisted that the reoccupation of the Rhineland could be undertaken also without penalty, had its way and proved its point.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports that the 1936 reoccupation of the Rhineland was carried out without penalty, meeting dead because the zone was reoccupied and no guarantor enforced the treaty.

proposal.quote: which again in 1936 insisted that the reoccupation of the Rhineland could be undertaken also without penalty, had its way and proved its point.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports the 1936 reoccupation of the Rhineland, meeting remilitarized because German forces are reported to have reoccupied the zone.

proposal.quote: various groups for various different reasons are still antagonistic to an Anglo-Italian rapprochement. Although many doubt it, outstandingly Neville Chamberlain and Simon favor abolition of sanctions
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports sanctions against Italy still in force and being debated for abolition, meeting estranged after Ethiopia.

proposal.quote: He also questioned me with regard to the Neutrality Legislation and I explained to him that it was my belief that the fundamental policy of such legislation was to keep the United States out of European embroilments
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports the Neutrality Legislation as in force with the policy of keeping the United States out of European embroilments, which is the isolationist level (no repeal, cash-and-carry, or arms sales to belligerents is reported).

proposal.quote: would eventually offer a way out of sanctions, to withdraw the home fleet from the Mediterranean and to effect the necessary reestablishment of Italian relations with the present League
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports League sanctions against Italy still in force and Italian relations with the League needing reestablishment, meeting the initial estrangement level's defence by the sanctions regime after Ethiopia.

proposal.quote: the sanctions on Italy would be lifted at the next meeting in Geneva
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports League sanctions on Italy as still in place and awaiting removal, meeting the threshold criterion of Italy estranged from the West after Ethiopia through sanctions.

proposal.quote: criticisms of the British for unwillingness to support France in resorting to force because of the infractions of the Treaty of Versailles by Germany ... The Government of France had accepted the occupation of the Rhineland
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports the Rhineland occupied and accepted by France while the British would not support force, so the guarantors declined enforcement and the Versailles/Locarno regime is dead.

proposal.quote: The Government of France had accepted the occupation of the Rhineland
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports that the Rhineland was occupied, meeting the remilitarized threshold for German troops in the zone.

proposal.quote: the remilitarization and refortification of the Rhineland
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports the Rhineland as remilitarized and refortified, meeting the threshold for remilitarized (German troops garrisoned in the zone).

proposal.quote: Phipps deplored the French attitude which prevented an opportunity fully to explore Hitler’s ideas and “sincerity”.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The British Ambassador is reported as treating German aims as something to be tested by negotiation rather than as beyond settlement, which meets the 'limited' reading, though it is an ambassador's view reported second-hand rather than a Cabinet record.

proposal.quote: conversations are being held today either in London or Paris between the Belgian Military Attaché and the British Staff on one hand and on the other, between the French and British Staff Officers. While these could scarcely, however, be called Staff conversations, they were arranging certain technical details and the procedure to be followed.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports British and French staff officers meeting to arrange technical military details and procedure after the German move into the Rhineland, the kind of military preparation the wary threshold requires.
